# opencode-tavily-proxy-quota

[![CI](https://github.com/lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-brightgreen)](./package.json)

An OpenCode 2 TUI plugin that shows the remaining Tavily API credits in the
session sidebar.

## Lineage

This is a fork of a fork:

| Repository | What it added |
|---|---|
| [cardin/opencode-tavily-quota](https://github.com/cardin/opencode-tavily-quota) | original: one key's `/usage` in the sidebar |
| [54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota](https://github.com/54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota) | pooled quota from a [TavilyProxyManager](https://github.com/xuncv/TavilyProxyManager) (`/api/stats`) |
| this fork | per-key breakdown (`/api/keys`), on-demand sync, clickable **Refresh** + **Details** buttons, Chinese/English UI, credential-handling fixes |

Without `proxyUrl` it behaves exactly like the original: one account's credits
from `api.tavily.com/usage`.

The same sidebar as text (the bar widths match OpenCode's built-in quota
section, so the two line up):

```
Tavily
 刷新额度   详情   距重置 5天12小时
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   32% 剩余
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░   16/19 个
可用6143/19000 · 最后 #19 · 3 个耗尽
```

The first bar is monthly credits left; the second counts keys in the proxy pool
that can still serve a request. Both are 25 cells plus a right-aligned label
column, so they line up with OpenCode's built-in quota section.

The English build (`"locale": "en"`) trades a cell of bar width for its wider
labels and stays on 36 columns:

```text
Tavily
 Refresh  Details  reset 5d 12h
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    32% left
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░  16/19 keys
6143/19000 left · last #19 · 3 spent
```


## Install

You need OpenCode 2 and a Tavily API key. **The reverse proxy is optional** —
without `proxyUrl` the plugin reads a single account's
`api.tavily.com/usage`, which is what most people want.

Pick whichever route suits the person installing it.

### 1. From a local clone (no build)

`dist/` is committed, so there is nothing to compile. You still need the
runtime packages the host does not inject:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota.git
cd opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts   # ~1 min, runtime deps only
```

Then point `cli.json` at the folder (see [Configuration](#configuration)):

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "/absolute/path/to/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": { "apiKey": "tvly-..." }
    }
  ]
}
```

Verified: with `--omit=dev` and no build, both root entries import cleanly
(`index.ts` → `PLUGIN_ID`, `default`; `tui.ts` → `TavilyQuotaTuiPlugin`,
`buildLines`, …). Skipping `npm install` entirely does **not** work — the plugin
resolves `@opencode/plugin` and `@opentui/solid` from its own `node_modules`.

This is the route to hand to someone who wants to avoid the babel build step.

### 2. From GitHub as a package

```sh
opencode plugin add github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
```

The install runs the package's `prepare` build, so this one builds `dist/` from
source and needs the dev dependencies too. Add the `options` block to
`cli.json` afterwards to pass a key.

Some OpenCode 2 builds fail this step inside their bundled npm
(`NpmInstallFailedError`); route 1 is the fallback when that happens.

### 3. From npm

Once published:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
```

Add the `options` block to `cli.json` for the key.

> If a copy already exists under
> `~/.config/opencode/plugins/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota/`, remove it after a
> package install so the plugin is not loaded twice.

The sidebar follows the built-in quota styling — the heading uses the default
text color and the body (bar included) uses the muted/subdued text color. A
countdown between the heading and the bar shows how long until the monthly
credits reset. It polls every 10 minutes and can be refreshed on demand with the
command below.

## Requirements

- OpenCode 2 (`opencode --version` reports `2.x`).
- A Tavily API key, supplied by:
  - `TAVILY_API_KEY` in the CLI environment,
  - the `apiKey` plugin option configured in `cli.json`, or
  - OpenCode's active Tavily connection (use `opencode auth login tavily` or
    `/connect` to connect Tavily).

The CLI environment takes precedence over `apiKey`; OpenCode's active
connection is used when neither supplies a key. The server resolves its saved
credential and fetches `/usage` itself. Only quota data returns to the TUI;
the saved key is never sent over plugin RPC or displayed. With a remote server,
install this plugin there too to use its active connection.

The `apiKey` option also accepts `{file:...}` and `{env:...}` references, which
the plugin expands itself because `cli.json` does not (unlike `opencode.jsonc`).

## Layout

```
index.ts         # server entrypoint: integration credential + quota RPC
rpc.ts           # shared RPC definition
tui.tsx          # TUI entrypoint: sidebar slot + command
usage.ts         # key resolution, /usage fetch, formatting
usage.test.ts    # unit tests for usage.ts
scripts/build.mjs
dist/            # built entrypoints shipped to npm
```

`npm run build` compiles the TypeScript/JSX sources into `dist/`, which is what
`package.json` exports and what npm publishes. Published plugins ship built
`dist/*.js`: OpenCode transpiles `.tsx` entrypoints as it loads them, and the
Solid JSX runtime (`@opentui/solid`) is only provided at runtime, not from the
installed plugin.

OpenCode installs package plugins under `~/.cache/opencode/npm/`. The server
entrypoint (`dist/index.js`) registers the quota RPC; the `tui` entrypoint
(`dist/tui.js`) renders the sidebar in the CLI.

## Configuration

If you already connected Tavily in OpenCode, no key option is needed. To pass
the API key as a plugin option instead, register the plugin in `cli.json`:

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "tvly-..."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The CLI-only `cli.json` entry also keeps the plugin active when the TUI is
connected to a remote server. The same entry accepts a `refreshMs` option to
override the default poll interval — 10 minutes in direct mode (Tavily's
`/usage` allows 10 requests per 10 minutes), 60 seconds in proxy mode (it only
reads the local cache).

### Language

The sidebar ships in Chinese and English:

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "<proxy master key>",
        "locale": "en"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`locale` is `"auto"` (default), `"zh"` or `"en"`. `"auto"` reads `LC_ALL` /
`LC_MESSAGES` / `LANG`, then the OS locale, and falls back to Chinese. Set it
explicitly if your terminal locale does not match what you want.

```text
Tavily
 Refresh  Details  reset 5d 12h
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    32% left
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░  16/19 keys
6143/19000 left · last #19 · 3 spent
```

### Buttons

- **Refresh** re-reads the proxy cache, then syncs every key from Tavily in the
  background (10–20 s on a large pool) and reports what happened.
- **Details** opens the per-key breakdown as a toast. It reads current state and
  never syncs, so it is instant. Same view as `/tavily-quota`.

### Keeping the key out of the file

`cli.json` is not processed like `opencode.jsonc`: OpenCode does not expand
`{file:...}` or `{env:...}` in plugin options, so the plugin does it. Use either
reference as `apiKey` to avoid pasting the raw key into `cli.json`:

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "{file:~/.secrets/tavily-api-key}"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`{env:NAME}` reads an environment variable (empty when unset). `{file:PATH}`
reads a file's trimmed contents, with `~/` expanding to the home directory and
relative paths resolving against the CLI's working directory. `TAVILY_API_KEY`
still wins over `apiKey` when both are set. A missing or unreadable file is
reported in the sidebar instead of being used as the key.

## Tavily proxy pool

[TavilyProxyManager](https://github.com/xuncv/TavilyProxyManager) is a
self-hosted reverse proxy that fronts a pool of Tavily API keys and picks a key
per request. Its `GET /api/stats` endpoint reports credits summed across the
whole pool. Set `proxyUrl` to read that endpoint instead of a single key's
`/usage`, and set `apiKey` to the proxy's **master key** (the credential clients
use to talk to the proxy, not a `tvly-` key):

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "<proxy master key>",
        "proxyUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:27890"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The sidebar then shows `limit = total_quota`, `remaining = total_remaining`, and
the heading reports the key count (`Tavily Pool (6 keys)`). A trailing slash on
`proxyUrl` is fine. `apiKey` still accepts `{env:...}`/`{file:...}` references,
so the master key can stay out of `cli.json`. The proxy must be reachable from
wherever the TUI runs.

Notes:

- The reset countdown still uses the calendar-month approximation. Pooled keys
  can belong to different accounts with different reset dates, so treat it as a
  rough indicator only.
- `total_quota` is the sum of each key's monthly allowance, which is what the
  sidebar bar is relative to; it is not a real single-account plan.
- `TAVILY_API_KEY` in the environment still wins over `apiKey`, so don't set it
  to a raw Tavily key when using a proxy.
- With `proxyUrl` set the plugin never calls `api.tavily.com` directly.

### Refresh behaviour

Proxy mode reads the local `<proxyUrl>/api/stats` cache, so the sidebar polls
every **60 seconds** and a refresh paints in well under a second. Direct mode
reads `api.tavily.com/usage`, which is limited to 10 requests per 10 minutes, so
it polls every **10 minutes**.

Pressing refresh (button, `/tavily-quota`, or the palette command) adds a
*sync*: the proxy re-reads every key's `/usage` on Tavily, one key at a time.
With a ~20-key pool that is ~19 upstream requests and takes 10–20 seconds, so
the cached numbers are painted first and the sync result is reported afterwards.

If the sync fails, the sidebar says so rather than showing a success:

```
⚠ 同步失败 19/19，数字为缓存
```

The proxy marks the job `completed` even when every key returned `429`, so the
plugin checks `succeeded`/`failed` rather than trusting the job status. Several
refreshes in quick succession can trip Tavily's rate limit; after that, syncs
fail until the window resets. The proxy's own auto-sync is the primary source of
freshness — treat the button as a manual override.

## Commands

- `/tavily-quota` — slash command that re-fetches and reports the current quota,
  the reset countdown, and what the sync actually did.
- "Refresh Tavily quota" — the same action from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

## Data source

`GET https://api.tavily.com/usage` with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The
plugin prefers the account plan (`account.plan_limit` / `account.plan_usage`,
e.g. `Researcher` with 1000 monthly credits) and falls back to the per-key limit
when the plan limit is absent. A `null` per-key limit (unlimited key) is
therefore handled.

The response has no reset timestamp, so the sidebar countdown is derived from
the calendar: Tavily resets credits on the first day of each month (not the
billing date), and the plugin assumes `00:00 UTC` for that reset. If Tavily
later exposes an explicit reset time, prefer it over this derivation.

## Development

`usage.ts` is deliberately free of OpenCode and OpenTUI imports so it can be
tested anywhere. The tests cover quota math, local-key precedence and fallback,
the connected-key RPC, and HTTP error handling using a mock `fetch`.

Run the tests and type check from the repository root:

```sh
npm install
npm test
npm run typecheck
```

## Notes

- The server handles OpenCode-connected credentials and their quota requests;
  the CLI handles local keys and renders TUI slots.

## Security

The Tavily key is never logged, never rendered, and never sent over the plugin
RPC boundary — only quota numbers cross it. `{file:...}` references are treated
as credentials and rejected if they are multi-line or longer than 512
characters. See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for scope and private reporting.

一个 OpenCode 2 的 TUI 插件：在会话侧边栏显示 Tavily API 的剩余额度。

## 血缘

这是 fork 的 fork：

| 仓库 | 它增加了什么 |
|---|---|
| [cardin/opencode-tavily-quota](https://github.com/cardin/opencode-tavily-quota) | 原始版本：侧边栏显示单把 key 的 `/usage` |
| [54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota](https://github.com/54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota) | 从 [TavilyProxyManager](https://github.com/xuncv/TavilyProxyManager) 的 `/api/stats` 读取池化额度 |
| 本 fork | 逐 key 明细（`/api/keys`）、按需同步、可点击的 **刷新** 与 **详情**、中英双语界面、凭证处理修正 |

不配 `proxyUrl` 时，行为与原始版本一致：只读 `api.tavily.com/usage` 里单个账号的额度。

同一条侧边栏以文本表示（条形宽度对齐 OpenCode 内置的额度区块，两处能对齐）：

```
Tavily
 刷新额度   详情   距重置 5天12小时
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   32% 剩余
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░   16/19 个
可用6143/19000 · 最后 #19 · 3 个耗尽
```

第一条是本月剩余额度，第二条统计代理池里仍能服务请求的 key 数。两条都是 25 格加一个右对齐标签列，因此与 OpenCode 内置额度区块对齐。

英文界面（`"locale": "en"`）为较宽的标签让出一格，总宽仍保持 36 列：

```text
Tavily
 Refresh  Details  reset 5d 12h
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    32% left
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░  16/19 keys
6143/19000 left · last #19 · 3 spent
```

## 安装

需要 OpenCode 2 和一个 Tavily API key。**反向代理是可选的** —— 不配 `proxyUrl` 时插件读取单个账号的 `api.tavily.com/usage`，这也是多数人需要的形态。

三种安装方式，挑一种。

### 1. 本地克隆（无需构建）

`dist/` 已随仓库提交，不必编译。但宿主不会注入运行时依赖，仍需安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota.git
cd opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts   # 约 1 分钟，仅运行时依赖
```

然后在 `cli.json` 里指向该目录（见 [配置](#配置)）：

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "/absolute/path/to/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": { "apiKey": "tvly-..." }
    }
  ]
}
```

已验证：`--omit=dev` 且不构建时，两个根入口都能正常 import（`index.ts` → `PLUGIN_ID`、`default`；`tui.ts` → `TavilyQuotaTuiPlugin`、`buildLines` 等）。完全跳过 `npm install` **不行** —— 插件需要从自己的 `node_modules` 解析 `@opencode/plugin` 与 `@opentui/solid`。

想避开 babel 构建的人，走这条路。

### 2. 从 GitHub 按包安装

```sh
opencode plugin add github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
```

安装会执行包里的 `prepare` 构建，所以这一条会从源码生成 `dist/`，也需要开发依赖。装完再往 `cli.json` 加 `options` 传 key。

部分 OpenCode 2 版本会在自带的 npm 里失败（`NpmInstallFailedError`），此时退回方式 1。

### 3. 从 npm 安装

发布之后：

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-tavily-proxy-quota
```

同样需要在 `cli.json` 里加 `options`。

> 如果 `~/.config/opencode/plugins/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota/` 下已有副本，按包安装后要删掉，否则插件会被加载两次。

侧边栏沿用内置额度区块的样式：标题用默认文字色，正文（含条形）用次级文字色。标题与条形之间显示到本月额度重置的倒计时。默认每 10 分钟轮询一次，也可以用下面的命令手动刷新。

## 环境要求

- OpenCode 2（`opencode --version` 显示 `2.x`）。
- 一个 Tavily API key，来源三选一：
  - CLI 环境变量 `TAVILY_API_KEY`；
  - `cli.json` 里的 `apiKey` 插件选项；
  - OpenCode 里已连接的 Tavily（`opencode auth login tavily` 或 `/connect`）。

CLI 环境变量优先级高于 `apiKey`；两者都没有时用 OpenCode 的已连接凭证。服务端自己解析保存的凭证并请求 `/usage`，只有额度数据回到 TUI，已保存的 key 不会经插件 RPC 传递，也不会显示。若 TUI 连接的是远程服务端，需在服务端也安装本插件才能用它的已连接凭证。

`apiKey` 还接受 `{file:...}` 与 `{env:...}` 引用，由插件自行展开，因为 `cli.json` 不像 `opencode.jsonc` 那样做展开。

## 布局

```
index.ts         # 服务端入口：集成凭证 + 额度 RPC
rpc.ts           # 共享 RPC 定义
tui.tsx          # TUI 入口：侧边栏槽位 + 命令
usage.ts         # key 解析、/usage 请求、格式化
usage.test.ts    # usage.ts 的单元测试
scripts/build.mjs
dist/            # 发布到 npm 的已构建入口
```

`npm run build` 把 TypeScript/JSX 源码编译进 `dist/`，`package.json` 的 `exports` 与 npm 发布都指向它。发布版带已构建的 `dist/*.js`：OpenCode 在加载时转译 `.tsx` 入口，而 Solid 的 JSX 运行时（`@opentui/solid`）只在运行时提供，不从已安装的插件里取。

OpenCode 把包插件装在 `~/.cache/opencode/npm/` 下。服务端入口（`dist/index.js`）注册额度 RPC，`tui` 入口（`dist/tui.js`）在 CLI 里渲染侧边栏。

## 配置

如果你已经在 OpenCode 里连过 Tavily，不需要任何 key 选项。要用插件选项传 key，在 `cli.json` 里登记：

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "tvly-..."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`cli.json` 只在 CLI 侧生效，因此当 TUI 连接远程服务端时，这条登记仍能让插件保持启用。同一处还接受 `refreshMs`，用来覆盖默认轮询间隔 —— 直连模式 10 分钟（Tavily 的 `/usage` 限每 10 分钟 10 次请求），代理模式 60 秒（只读本地缓存）。

### 语言

侧边栏提供中文与英文：

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "<proxy master key>",
        "locale": "en"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`locale` 取 `"auto"`（默认）、`"zh"` 或 `"en"`。`"auto"` 依次读 `LC_ALL` / `LC_MESSAGES` / `LANG`，再读操作系统区域设置，最后回落到中文。终端区域设置与期望不符时，显式指定即可。

```text
Tavily
 Refresh  Details  reset 5d 12h
████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    32% left
▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░  16/19 keys
6143/19000 left · last #19 · 3 spent
```

### 按钮

- **刷新** 先读代理缓存，再在后台从 Tavily 同步每一把 key（大池子需 10–20 秒），最后报告结果。
- **详情** 以 toast 打开逐 key 明细。它只读当前状态、从不触发同步，因此是即时的。与 `/tavily-quota` 是同一视图。

### 让 key 不落在文件里

`cli.json` 不经过 `opencode.jsonc` 那套处理：OpenCode 不会展开插件选项里的 `{file:...}` 或 `{env:...}`，所以由插件来做。两种引用都可以用作 `apiKey`，避免把明文 key 粘进 `cli.json`：

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "{file:~/.secrets/tavily-api-key}"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`{env:NAME}` 读环境变量（未设置时为空）。`{file:PATH}` 读文件并去掉首尾空白，`~/` 展开为家目录，相对路径按 CLI 的工作目录解析。两者同时存在时，`TAVILY_API_KEY` 仍优先于 `apiKey`。文件缺失或不可读会在侧边栏报错，而不是当作 key 使用。

## Tavily 代理池

[TavilyProxyManager](https://github.com/xuncv/TavilyProxyManager) 是自建的反向代理，前面是一池 Tavily key，每个请求挑一把。它的 `GET /api/stats` 汇报整池汇总的额度。设置 `proxyUrl` 即可读这个端点而不再读单 key 的 `/usage`，同时把 `apiKey` 设为代理的 **master key**（客户端访问代理用的凭证，不是 `tvly-` 开头的 key）：

```json title="cli.json"
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "github:lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "<proxy master key>",
        "proxyUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:27890"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

侧边栏随即显示 `limit = total_quota`、`remaining = total_remaining`，标题带上 key 数（`Tavily Pool (6 keys)`）。`proxyUrl` 末尾多一个斜杠也没问题。`apiKey` 同样接受 `{env:...}`/`{file:...}`，master key 不必写进 `cli.json`。代理必须能从 TUI 所在位置访问到。

说明：

- 重置倒计时仍用按自然月近似。池里的 key 可能属于不同账号、重置日不同，所以只能当粗略提示。
- `total_quota` 是各 key 月度额度的加总，是侧边栏条形的基准，不对应任何真实套餐。
- 环境变量里的 `TAVILY_API_KEY` 仍优先于 `apiKey`，用代理时不要把它设成裸 Tavily key。
- 配了 `proxyUrl` 后，插件不再直接请求 `api.tavily.com`。

### 刷新行为

代理模式读本地 `<proxyUrl>/api/stats` 缓存，因此侧边栏每 **60 秒** 轮询一次，手动刷新在一秒内出图。直连模式读 `api.tavily.com/usage`，受每 10 分钟 10 次限制，因此每 **10 分钟** 轮询一次。

按下刷新（按钮、`/tavily-quota` 或命令面板）会额外触发一次 *同步*：代理逐把重新向 Tavily 请求 `/usage`。20 把左右的池子约 19 次上游请求，耗时 10–20 秒，所以先画出缓存数字，事后再报告同步结果。

同步失败时如实提示，不装作成功：

```
⚠ 同步失败 19/19，数字为缓存
```

代理即使每把 key 都返回 `429`，也会把任务标为 `completed`，因此插件检查 `succeeded`/`failed`，而不信任任务状态。短时间内连续刷新可能触发 Tavily 的限流，之后同步会一直失败到窗口重置。保持新鲜度主要靠代理自身的自动同步 —— 把按钮当作手动兜底。

## 命令

- `/tavily-quota` —— 斜杠命令，重新取额度并报告当前值、重置倒计时，以及同步实际做了什么。
- `Refresh Tavily quota` —— 命令面板（`Ctrl+P`）里的同一动作。

## 数据来源

`GET https://api.tavily.com/usage`，带 `Authorization: Bearer <key>`。插件优先用账号套餐（`account.plan_limit` / `account.plan_usage`，例如 `Researcher` 每月 1000 credits），套餐上限缺失时回落到单 key 上限，因此单 key 上限为 `null`（无限额 key）也能处理。

响应里没有重置时间戳，所以倒计时按日历推算：Tavily 在每月 1 日（不是账单日）重置额度，插件按 `00:00 UTC` 计算。若将来 Tavily 提供明确的重置时间，应优先使用它。

## 开发

`usage.ts` 刻意不 import OpenCode 与 OpenTUI 的任何东西，因此随处可测。测试覆盖额度计算、本地 key 的优先级与回落、已连接 key 的 RPC，以及用 mock `fetch` 的 HTTP 错误处理。

在仓库根目录跑测试与类型检查：

```sh
npm install
npm test
npm run typecheck
```

## 说明

- 服务端负责 OpenCode 已连接的凭证及其额度请求；CLI 负责本地 key 与 TUI 槽位渲染。

## 安全

Tavily key 从不记入日志、从不渲染、也从不跨越插件 RPC 边界 —— 只有额度数字过去。`{file:...}` 引用按凭证对待，多行或超过 512 字符会被拒绝。范围说明与私密报告方式见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。

## 贡献

见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)。改动记录在 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。原始工作来自
[cardin](https://github.com/cardin/opencode-tavily-quota) 与
[54cwh](https://github.com/54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota)；本 fork 沿用同一许可与版权声明。

All notable changes to this fork. Format follows

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` (Contributor Covenant 2.1) and a pull request template,
  filling the gaps in GitHub's community profile.
- `publish.yml` now checks for the `NPM_TOKEN` secret before publishing and, when
  it is absent, skips with an actionable job summary instead of failing with a
  bare `ENEEDAUTH`.
- Dependabot version updates for npm are disabled (`open-pull-requests-limit: 0`).
  `@opentui/solid` pins `solid-js` exactly, so automated bumps of one without the
  other always fail; two of the three PRs this repo received were that. Security
  updates stay enabled. Workflow actions still get monthly bumps.

## [1.3.2] — 2026-10-27

Distribution only — no behaviour change.

### Added

- `tui.ts` at the repo root. OpenCode loads a directory plugin from entry files
  at the plugin root and does not read `package.json` exports in that mode, so
  without this file a path install reported `features: { server: true }` only
  and the sidebar never rendered.
- `publish.yml`, a manual npm publish workflow (needs an `NPM_TOKEN` secret).

### Changed

- `dist/` is committed instead of ignored, so a clone needs no babel build —
  only `npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts` for the runtime packages the
  host does not inject. A bare clone without `node_modules` does not load:
  `@opencode/plugin` and `@opentui/solid` must resolve from the plugin directory.
  CI rebuilds and fails if the committed output drifts from the source.
- README install section documents all three routes: local clone (no build),
  GitHub package (builds on install), npm.

## [1.3.1] — 2026-10-26

### Changed

- The sidebar's bottom line now labels its leading figure: `可用6085/19000 ·
  最后 #19 · 3 个耗尽` instead of a bare `6085/19000`. English uses
  `6085/19000 left` to match the `32% left` bar above and stay within 36
  columns. The label consumes the 3-column headroom that line had; a test now
  asserts it against the sidebar width exactly, in both locales.

## [1.3.0] — 2026-10-26

### Added

- **Details button** in the sidebar, between Refresh and the reset countdown.
  It opens the per-key breakdown as a toast — the same view as
  `/tavily-quota` — without triggering a Tavily sync, so it is instant.
- **English UI** alongside Chinese. Pick with the new `locale` option
  (`auto` / `zh` / `en`); `auto` reads `LC_ALL`/`LANG` then the OS locale and
  falls back to Chinese. Label widths are derived per locale, so both builds
  stay on the 36-column sidebar.

### Changed

- `/tavily-quota` and the palette command now show the detail view instead of
  forcing a sync. Refresh is the button that syncs.
- `usage.ts` formatters take an optional `locale`; the default stays Chinese, so
  existing behaviour is unchanged.
- `scripts/build.mjs` also emits `dist/i18n.js`.

## [1.2.0] — 2026-10-26

Refreshing was slow and quietly wrong. Both are fixed.

### Fixed

- **Manual refresh no longer freezes the sidebar for 10–20 s.** It paints the
  proxy's cached numbers first (measured ~50 ms warm), then runs the Tavily
  sync in the background and repaints when it finishes.
- **A failed sync is no longer reported as success.** The proxy marks the job
  `completed` even when every key came back `429`; the plugin now reads
  `succeeded`/`failed` as well. On failure the sidebar shows
  `⚠ 同步失败 19/19，数字为缓存` and the toast carries the first upstream error.
- **Proxy mode polls every 60 s** instead of every 10 minutes. Direct mode keeps
  the 10-minute interval because `api.tavily.com/usage` allows 10 requests per
  10 minutes; `<proxyUrl>/api/stats` is local, so that limit does not apply.

### Changed

- `syncProxyUsage` returns a `SyncOutcome`
  (`completed` / `partial` / `failed` / `timeout` / `unavailable`) instead of a
  boolean, and no longer treats "job finished" as "keys refreshed".
- `fetchQuota` attaches that outcome as `result.sync` when `sync: true`.

### Notes

A refresh re-reads every key's `/usage` on Tavily, one key at a time — with a
~20-key pool that is ~19 upstream requests per click. Several refreshes in quick
succession trip Tavily's rate limit (`429`), after which syncs fail until the
window resets. The proxy's own auto-sync is the primary source of freshness;
treat the button as a manual override, not a polling mechanism.

## [1.1.1] — 2026-10-26

Security and correctness hardening after a local audit.

### Fixed

- **Key precedence in proxy mode.** `resolveApiKey` now takes an explicit
  `pooled` flag from its caller instead of re-deriving pooled mode from
  `options.proxyUrl`. Previously, if `TAVILY_API_KEY` was set (a raw `tvly-`
  key) it would preempt the proxy master key and the proxy would answer 401.
  The fix no longer depends on `proxyUrl` being threaded through every caller.
- **`{file:...}` could read arbitrary files.** Contents containing whitespace or
  newlines, or longer than 512 characters, are now rejected, so a file
  reference cannot ship a multi-line secret (SSH key, `.env`) as a Bearer token.
- **`/api/keys` 401/403 was invisible.** It now degrades to a visible warning
  (`snapshot.poolWarning`, rendered as `⚠`) instead of silently showing pool
  numbers that may be stale. `404`/timeouts still degrade silently, as before.
- **`syncProxyUsage` timeout.** The remaining budget is recomputed each poll
  instead of using a 1000 ms floor, so the sync deadline is honoured.

### Added

- CI workflow: typecheck, tests, build, and a dist syntax check on Node 24.
- Issue forms (bug report / feature request), Dependabot config.
- `SECURITY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.gitattributes`, this changelog.
- 5 regression tests (57 → 62): pooled precedence, proxy-mode bearer token,
  multi-line and oversized file references, and `/api/keys` 401.

### Changed

- `package.json` repository/bugs/homepage point at this fork.
- The local `patch-usage.mjs` shim (maintainer's deployment, not part of this
  repository) is now a compatibility no-op that recognises the fixed source.

  `/api/keys` and on-demand sync via `/api/keys/sync`.
- Chinese sidebar and detail view; display-width-aware label alignment.

# Contributing

Thanks for looking. This is a personal fork, but issues and pull requests are
welcome — small, focused ones are easiest to review.

## What this repository is

A fork of [54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota](https://github.com/54cwh/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota),
itself a fork of [cardin/opencode-tavily-quota](https://github.com/cardin/opencode-tavily-quota).
It adds pooled-quota support, a Chinese sidebar, per-key detail, and a
credential-precedence fix. If a change applies upstream, consider offering it
there too — it will reach more people.

## Development

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build      # writes dist/, which is gitignored
```

Requirements: Node >= 22 (developed on 24).

`npm test` runs both suites:

- `usage.test.ts` — quota math, key resolution, `{file:...}` expansion, proxy
  mode, `/api/keys` degradation. Pure functions plus a mocked `fetch`; no
  network and no real credentials.
- `index.test.ts` — the server-side RPC entrypoint.

## Layout

```
index.ts         server entrypoint: registers the quota RPC
rpc.ts           shared RPC definition (only quota data crosses it)
tui.tsx          TUI entrypoint: sidebar slot, refresh button, /tavily-quota
usage.ts         key resolution, HTTP, derivation, formatting (no TUI imports)
scripts/build.mjs
dist/            build output, not committed
```

`usage.ts` deliberately imports nothing from OpenCode or OpenTUI so it stays
testable in isolation. Please keep it that way.

## When changing behaviour

- Add or update a test in `usage.test.ts`. The exotic paths (`{file:...}`,
  proxy 401, `/api/keys` 404) are exactly the ones that break silently.
- Update `README.md` if an option, command, or the rendered output changes.
- If you touch credential handling, read `SECURITY.md` first. Two properties must
  hold: the key never leaves the process except as a request header to the
  configured endpoint, and a rejected credential is never presented as success.

## Builds and the local patch

Earlier versions of this fork required running a `patch-usage.mjs` shim after
every build, because the key-precedence fix lived only in `dist/`. That fix is
now in `usage.ts` (see `resolveApiKey`'s `pooled` flag), so a plain
`npm run build` is sufficient. The shim belongs to the maintainer's local
deployment and is **not** part of this repository.

## Commits

Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, `chore:`) with a body that says
what changed and why. One logical change per commit.

# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security problem.

Use GitHub's private reporting instead:
[Security → Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/lichenzhao060507/opencode-tavily-proxy-quota/security/advisories/new).

If that is unavailable, open an issue that says only that you have a security
report and how to reach you — no details, no proof of concept.

Expect an initial reply within about a week. This is a personal fork maintained
on a best-effort basis, not a funded project; there is no bug bounty.

## Scope

This plugin runs inside your OpenCode process and handles a credential. The
parts that matter:

- **Credential handling.** The Tavily key (or the TavilyProxyManager master key)
  is read from `TAVILY_API_KEY`, the `apiKey` plugin option, or OpenCode's saved
  Tavily integration. It is never logged, never rendered in the sidebar, and
  never sent over the plugin RPC boundary — only quota numbers cross it.
- **`{file:...}` references.** A file reference is treated as a credential: its
  contents are rejected if they contain whitespace/newlines or exceed 512
  characters, so the option cannot be pointed at a multi-line secret.
- **Proxy mode.** With `proxyUrl` set the plugin talks only to that proxy and
  never to `api.tavily.com`.
- **`/api/keys`.** When the proxy rejects the credential (401/403) the sidebar
  says so instead of showing stale numbers.

Out of scope: the TavilyProxyManager itself, OpenCode's own credential storage,
and anything that requires an attacker to already control your configuration
file or your machine.

## Hardening notes

The 2026-10-26 audit that produced the current behaviour is recorded in
[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) under `1.1.1`. In short: an explicit `pooled` flag
for key precedence, a credential-shape guard on `{file:...}`, and a visible
warning when `/api/keys` authentication fails.
